threat_event: Counterfeit or tampered network products bought from a marketplace seller or broker are resold to customers, or reach a DoD delivery
threat_source: Counterfeiters; compromised or dishonest marketplace sellers and brokers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 10% of purchases from a marketplace and brokers; no OEM serial validation, packaging inspection, or firmware check on receipt; sourcing rule not written; 2 cloned optic serials found in P07 testing
affected_asset_or_process: BP-02 purchasing and receiving; BP-03 DoD staging; customer networks
regulatory_driver: N42-R05 (52.204-25(b)(1)); N42-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a) truthful 'new and genuine' claims)
existing_controls: About 90% bought from authorized distributors; DoD orders bought from distributor A only (unwritten); OEM partner serial lookup available
treatment_plan: Written sourcing rule: authorized sources only for DoD orders and for any device that routes traffic; OEM serial lookup, seal and packaging inspection, and firmware hash check on every non-authorized purchase; broker vetting; quarantine shelf; P08 runbook

threat_event: Supplier or broker mailbox compromise used to redirect a wire payment to a fraudulent account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Wire instructions and bank-detail changes accepted by email with no call-back; a $2,340 loss on 2026-05-19; no insurance cover for funds transfer fraud
affected_asset_or_process: BP-04 supplier payments; SYS-02 email; SYS-09 bank
treatment_plan: Call-back on a number already on file before any first payment or bank-detail change; pay marketplace sellers only through the marketplace; card instead of wire where possible; quarterly fraud awareness review

threat_event: Takeover of the accounting and inventory SaaS administrator account exposes customer pricing and DoD order records and lets an attacker change invoice payment details
threat_source: Cybercriminal (credential stuffing with a reused password)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on the administrator account; one password reused across 4 services; sign-in history never reviewed
existing_controls: Vendor password rules; vendor SOC 2 controls
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA with an authenticator app; password manager with unique passphrases; monthly sign-in and payment-detail review

threat_event: The owner cannot achieve and affirm CMMC Level 1 (Self) by the prime's 2026-10-30 deadline, or affirms without meeting all 15 requirements
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 10 of 15 FAR 52.204-21 requirements not MET in 2026-08; no POA&M allowed at Level 1 (32 CFR 170.21(a)(1)); no SPRS account; one person does all the work
existing_controls: This gap analysis (P03); IT consultant support
treatment_plan: Close every FAR gap by 2026-10-15 (P03 action list); final self-assessment with the IT consultant on 2026-10-23; SPRS entry and affirmation only when all 15 are met; tell the prime early if the date slips

threat_event: Email account takeover (phishing or SIM swap) is used to send fake invoices to customers and to read FCI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA by SMS codes only; no carrier account PIN; reused password
existing_controls: SMS second factor; provider spam filtering
treatment_plan: Authenticator app instead of SMS; carrier account PIN; unique passphrase; review mail forwarding rules monthly

threat_event: FCI and customer pricing pasted into a consumer AI assistant are kept or used for training by the vendor
threat_source: Owner error; AI service provider terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consumer plan with training on; no rule on what data may be pasted; 52 DoD order lines pasted in 2026-05 and 2026-07
treatment_plan: Turn training off; delete the chats; business plan with no-training terms; strip DoD lines and customer names before any upload (P10)

threat_event: Open 'anyone with the link' file links expose asset tag spreadsheets (FCI) and customer quotes
threat_source: Owner error; anyone who obtains a link
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default sharing set to anyone with the link; 14 open links to the prime never expire
treatment_plan: Remove open links; share with named people only; 30-day link expiry

threat_event: Attacker takes over the home router and reaches the business laptop or intercepts traffic
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default admin password and internet remote management (found and fixed 2026-08-06 in P07); firmware about 2 years old; household devices on the same flat network
existing_controls: Router firewall blocks inbound traffic; laptop host firewall; password changed and remote management off 2026-08-06
treatment_plan: Update router firmware; business-only Wi-Fi network for the laptop; check router settings every quarter

threat_event: Admin passwords for customer network devices are stolen from a spreadsheet and used to attack customer networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 30 customer device passwords in a spreadsheet in cloud storage
treatment_plan: Move the passwords to the password manager vault; delete the spreadsheet and its versions; ask customers to rotate the passwords

threat_event: Covered telecommunications or video surveillance equipment (including a white-label unit) is delivered on a DoD order, or found and not reported within 1 business day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No Section 889 screening of brands or white-label products; no reporting procedure; clause not in the owner's own purchase orders
existing_controls: DoD orders bought from distributor A only; owner knows the five named manufacturers
treatment_plan: Covered-manufacturer check on every DoD quote, including the true OEM of white-label items; reporting steps in P08; clause substance on the owner's purchase orders for DoD-bound items

threat_event: The owner is suddenly unavailable (illness or injury) or loses the only phone, so nobody can reach accounts, stock, or the prime
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; second factors on one phone; no emergency sheet
treatment_plan: Emergency sheet; sealed recovery codes with the owner's attorney; distributor account notes; written agreement with the prime (P05)

threat_event: Data on old devices and returned customer equipment is disclosed (unwiped phone trade-in, laptops, trade-in switches with customer configurations)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No sanitization method or record; 2 old laptops unwiped; 2 trade-in switches held customer configurations
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 old laptops; SYS-06 old phone; returned stock
treatment_plan: Wipe method per device type with a disposal record; factory reset and verify every returned network device before resale

threat_event: Staged DoD equipment or stock is stolen or tampered with in the garage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Household and a dog walker can enter; cabinet key on the house key hook; keypad code never changed; no entry log
existing_controls: Garage door kept closed; steel cabinet
treatment_plan: Key lockbox; new keypad code; staged equipment always in the cabinet; simple entry log

threat_event: Laptop failure or ransomware destroys serial-to-tag spreadsheets and local files with no backup
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No laptop backup; spreadsheets often saved only on the laptop; file storage has only a 30-day recycle bin
treatment_plan: Save staging spreadsheets only in cloud storage; backup service with version history for the laptop and files

threat_event: A hurricane or long power outage closes the home office and garage for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single location; stock and staging on site
existing_controls: SaaS reachable from anywhere over a phone hotspot; distributors drop-ship commercial orders
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Move stock off the garage floor and take the laptop when a storm watch is issued; tell the prime of delivery delays
